author: d7
term: 長者長法身、短者短法身
reasonBefore: Complete paired formula that the long manifests a long Dharma-body and the short a short Dharma-body, asserting responsive manifestation without erasing distinctions.
reasonAfter: Complete paired formula that the long manifests a long Dharma-body and the short a short Dharma-body; both cases present responsive manifestation while denying that Dharma-body has fixed length.
reviewFindingAddressed: Removed the unsupported suggestion that distinctions remain fixed and stated the shared corpus result: responsive manifestation while both cases deny fixed Dharma-body length.
